# openapi-to-rust

> openapi-to-rust is an open-source OpenAPI generator focused on modern Rust. It generates strongly typed models, async Reqwest clients, SSE clients, and opt-in Axum server scaffolding from OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 documents, with experimental OpenAPI 3.2 parsing.

## Primary documentation

- [Overview](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/)
- [Getting started](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/docs/getting-started)
- [Rust client generation](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/docs/rust-client-generator)
- [Axum server generation](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/openapi-to-axum)
- [Compatibility](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/compatibility)
- [Generator comparisons](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/compare)
- [Progenitor comparison](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/compare/progenitor)
- [OpenAPI Generator comparison](https://openapi-to-rust.dev/compare/openapi-generator)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/gpu-cli/openapi-to-rust)
- [Rust API documentation](https://docs.rs/openapi-to-rust)

## Install

`cargo install --locked openapi-to-rust`
